AttributeDetail.SourceString:
环合强度提高异能环合的效果。当异能环合触发时，「创生」、「黯星」、「浊燃」生效的环合强度取决于参与异能环合的两者最终效果数值较高的一方；「覆纹」、「浸染」取决于造成伤害者。
当前环合强度能够让
「创生」、「黯星」、「浊燃」造成的伤害提高{0}%。
「覆纹」、「浸染」的伤害额外提高{1}%。
AttributeDetail.LocalizedString:
Cycle Intensity enhances Esper Cycle effects. When an Esper Cycle is triggered, its effective Cycle Intensity is determined by the participant with the higher final effect value.
Current Cycle Intensity increases 
Blossom, Nova, and Scorch DMG by {0}%.
Additionally, increases Hexed and Stain DMG by {1}%.

AttributeDetail.SourceString:
倾陷强度可以提升倾陷伤害。(倾陷伤害由小队成员共同影响，每个角色的倾陷强度只影响自身部分)
当前该角色倾陷伤害提升{0}%
AttributeDetail.LocalizedString:
Break Intensity enhances Break Damage. (Break Damage is calculated for the whole team, but each character's Break Intensity affects only their own contribution.)
Current character's Break Damage +{0}%
